0,0.description: repaint this top-down pixel art map of the United States as an isometric tycoon game world with highly detailed HD painterly pixel art shading with layered depth, warm late-afternoon light and a saturated palette: the ground stays a top-down map with every coastline, river, state line and highway exactly where it is, but the mountain ranges rise as shaded isometric peaks with snow, the forests become clusters of tiny isometric trees, the farmland a patchwork of fields with tiny barns, every city skyline becomes a small cluster of isometric buildings with lit windows and every town dot a few tiny isometric houses; high summer: deep green woods, golden and green farmland, bright desert, snow only on the highest peaks. Never write any words, names, letters or labels anywhere on the map. Landmarks to draw at the cities in this part of the map (draw them, never their names): Seattle with the Space Needle, ferries on Puget Sound, port cranes and Mount Rainier behind; Oakland and San Francisco with the Bay Bridge, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Transamerica Pyramid and port cranes; Denver with the Rockies behind it, Union Station and the cash-register building; Las Vegas with the Strip's casino towers, the Stratosphere, the Sphere and neon; Salt Lake City with temple spires under the Wasatch and the Great Salt Lake; Portland with the St. Johns Bridge and Mount Hood behind; Fresno with a water tower among orchards and vineyards under the Sierra; Stockton with its inland port and delta waterways.
